paragraphs.text: Caution: rates are the 2020 SARS policy examples (Rebate Item 670.04) from the project's evidence pack - not tax advice.

Static findings from dw.vw_DataQuality (not live-computable from the fields loaded in this app): 203,309 usage-logbook rows carry RegNumbers absent from the equipment master. 14,746 fuel issues exceed 1.5x the receiving vehicle's tank size.
